title: Galaxy cluster MACS0416 (Hubble and Webb composite image)

evidence.locator: 4457 x 4133 px original; Visible light from Hubble and infrared from Webb, 0.4 to 5 µm, shown as color: the shortest wavelengths blue, the longest red. The file's embedded AVM tags give 0.0300 arcsec per pixel and north -67.64 deg right of vertical, and state Creative Commons Attribution 4.0. Measured against Gaia DR3: 5 of the 5 catalogued sources in the frame have a peak at their place, rms 0.06 arcsec, giving 0.0300 arcsec per pixel, north -67.71 deg right of vertical, centre 64.037488, -24.074332, a field of 2.23 x 2.06 arcmin; the centre moves 0.29 arcsec from the tags' place.
